title: When intake is empty, point at qa:bucket --next instead of staying silent
body:
When `intake/queue/` is empty, `loop.sh` does **not** look at the playtest shelf. Default: fall through to the assessor’s own candidates (`await_queued_work` is opt-in via `AI_LOOP_IDLE_WHEN_EMPTY=1`). `report_qa_bucket` only prints `npm run work -- --list` and never fails the cycle.

That is correct for not blocking on the fleet. It is silent about **where to look when the team is out of queued work**. The idle shelf is `qa/tickets/` — accumulating and corroborated-but-not-promoted-this-week findings. `npm run qa:bucket -- --next` already prints the highest-priority actionable ticket; `--all` is the full listing.

**Ask:** when the working board is empty, print one line pointing at that shelf (`qa:bucket -- --next`), without promoting those tickets into intake. `intake/queue` stays the short working board; `qa/tickets` stays the place you browse when idle.

Do not treat a 100-player Grok 4.6 (low) wave’s `derivePromotion` auto-corroboration (reference-tier stamp in `blind-tester/catalogs/grok_cli.json`) as filling the working board. The shelf is for that volume.
